segments.text: Number 3... I'm starting dinner now. We have an unexpected guest tonight.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Really? I thought we were going to eat at the new Thai restaurant.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Dad is bringing Grandma over, and she doesn't like spicy food. Could you set the table?

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Sure. I'll make a salad too. The soup and chicken should be enough for the main dishes.

segments.text: Question. Why is the man preparing dinner at home?
